text:
alice: Heads up — nightly integration run just flipped red against hosted API. Failing primarily in auth + streaming + tool-call tests. 401s plus a surge of 503s on tool endpoints. CI report: https://ci.redwood-inference/runs/67890 :grimacing:

ci-bot: build 67890 failed: hosted_integ.AuthStreamToolCallTest::test_toolcall_endtoend
https://ci.redwood-inference/runs/67890/logs

ben: @alice can you paste the smallest failing snippet? my money is on JWKS/kid rotation or stale token cache. :eyes:

alice: here's the failing header/body snippet we pulled from the runner:
```
> GET /v1/stream?session=abc123 HTTP/1.1
> Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImtfMjAyNi0wMy0xNyJ9...
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="redwood", error="invalid_token", error_description="kid not found"
```

dina: i'm also seeing intermittent 503s from the tool-runtime pool during the same window. logs show "no available runtimes" right after the stream handshake. suspect capacity OOM or scaling flaps. snippet:
```
tool-runtime: ERROR cannot checkout runtime: pool exhausted
stack: runtime_pool.Get -> StartRuntime -> OOM
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```

eric: pinging infra/sre for any JWKS rotations in the last hour. @sre-oncall any config pushes? Also can we request a targeted rerun of the affected shards?

ben: scheduling targeted reruns now — running shards 12,18,24 in parallel (quick smoke + full toolcall). Command: `ci rerun --shards 12,18,24 --priority=high`

ci-bot: rerun queued: 3 shards. expected finish ~20m. https://ci.redwood-inference/runs/67890/reruns/1

dina: on the header capture — i'll run `tcpdump` on the runner and curl the failing endpoint with `-v` to capture raw headers and the kid in the token. will upload to /tmp/ci-captures/3961234567.tar.gz when done. :white_check_mark:

alice: can we also flip a smoke-only routing fallback to dedicated-capacity for these tests while we triage? i want to keep the PR gates green if possible. config key: `ROUTE_POLICY=smoke:prefer:dedicated` — is that safe to toggle?

eric: we can do a smoke-only route override, but need a quick config push to the control plane and notify the routing service. i'll coordinate with SRE, but prefer to see rerun first to avoid masking the root cause.

ben: bisect started — narrowing commits touching auth-proxy, jwks refresh, and tool-serializer from the last 6 merges. will post commit pointers as i eliminate suspects.

ci-bot: rerun shard-12: failed (401s), shard-18: passed, shard-24: flaky (503 then ok). Summary: http://ci.redwood-inference/runs/67890/reruns/1/summary

dina: update from capture: token kid reported by client = `k_2026_03_17` but JWKS endpoint only returns `k_2026_03_16`. looks like rotation lag between key publish + cache expiry.

alice: thanks. if bisect lands on rotation/timing, propose a hotfix: accept previous kid for a 10m grace window or extend JWKS cache TTL slightly. i started a draft in PR #4521 and added label `ci-blocker`.

ben: noted. tagging @eric to own infra rotation follow-up. assigning PR and alerting SRE.

eric: picking this up. i'll coordinate with SRE to check key-publish pipeline and metrics. if rerun still fails after fixes, i'll attempt the smoke-only route flip as a mitigation.

sre-oncall: acked — looking at key-publish logs now, will report back within 10m. also checking tool-runtime scaling events around the failure window.

alice: appreciate it. quick ask: if anyone lands a short-term workaround, drop a one-line summary in the PR and ping this thread. don't let the nightly block other merges. :pray:

ben: will post bisect updates here. current suspect commit range: a3b2..f4e7 touching `auth-proxy/jwks_refresh.go`.

dina: upload complete: /tmp/ci-captures/3961234567.tar.gz (contains raw headers + token samples).

eric: SRE reports a delayed job in key-publish queue at 03:12 UTC, likely the rotation gap. pushing a hotfix to allow 10m grace and re-triggering publish.

ci-bot: hotfix deployment started: rollout/hotfix-jwks-grace -> expected 5m to propagate. https://ci.redwood-inference/deploys/8901

ben: re-running failing shards after hotfix. `ci rerun --shards 12,24 --after-deploy=hotfix-jwks-grace`

ci-bot: reruns complete: shard-12 passed, shard-24 passed (flaky earlier). nightly status: green again.

alice: great work team — thanks for the quick triage. i'll add postmortem notes in the release channel and follow up on a more robust fix (longer term: ensure atomic publish + cache invalidation). :raised_hands:

eric: leaving follow-up ticket for key-publish reliability and adding extra observability on JWKS latency.

ben: closing bisect — culprit narrowed to job queue race, PR #4521 merged as hotfix. :thumbsup:

dina: will mark artifacts + captures for retention for 7 days in case we need them later.

sre-oncall: monitoring looks stable. will keep an eye for 24h spikes.

alice: thanks all. I'll unlabel `ci-blocker` once the hotfix is in prod for 24h. Good catch.
